Messages.Body:
"freakdrivr" <freak...@gmail.com> wrote in message
news:5b657965.04092...@posting.google.com...
> "LSJ" <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote in message
news:<2rb6erF...@uni-berlin.de>...

> > Immortal Grapple (inferior) costs 0 when played by Rock Cat or any
> > other minion.
>
> Interesting - i read that card as applying to discipline cards that
> have a superior version of a discipline on the card and not whether a
> minion is playing it inferior or superior. ie. anarch 3-ways are not
> affected.

A card played required whatever it required to be played.

If you play inferior Immortal Grapple, then it requires inferior Potence
(that is, you don't need superior Potence to play Immortal Grapple at
inferior - the superior Discipline is not required).

Similarly, Ashes to Ashes can be used to prevent the damage from Blood Rage
when played at [thn], since that play doesn't require Fortitude.
